text: Ko Alla woni taguɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, O tagi ko woni hakkunde majji kon e nder balɗe jeegoo. Himo hattani tagugol ɗi e nder dumunna ɓurɗo fotoowo ma majaango. Refti O toowi O fotondiri ka dow "Arsi", no haandiri e mawngu Makko. Alanaa on, onon ɓee yimɓe, gaanin Alla, giɗo heftoowo fii mon, maa tefanoowo on ka Joomi mon. E on waajitotaako, rewon Alla taguɗo on, hara on rewidaali Mo e goɗɗum goo?
